caption:
Your English is fine. You just need practice.

Use voice mode in ChatGPT or Gemini and paste this:

Be my English speaking partner. Ask me one interview question at a time and correct my mistakes after each answer.

10 minutes a day beats 10 tips you never use. Send this to the friend who freezes in interviews.
